name: Palimpsest Recovery Dipper
tactics: Opens in Virtual, uses Viral Strike against exposed DHFs, then withdraws behind recovery personnel rather than risking its sleeve.

name: Palimpsest Retrieval Hitman
tactics: Uses cover, suppressive fire and close coordination. Orders the team to preserve cortical stacks whenever possible.

name: Compromised Protectorate Officer
tactics: Uses legal authority first, Stun when practical, and lethal force only once the party is framed as an immediate threat.

name: Praetorian Black-Recovery Operative
tactics: Uses targeting, linked weapons and armor to dominate open fire lanes. Breaks contact if Palimpsest can be preserved by retreat.
